questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Listen to a lot of live music. Bimhuis is free on tuesdays, Kalemegdan typically has music on wednesdays, Vondelbunker typically has music on fridays. All of it is free. 
https://jazzin.amsterdam/
